conventions.format: Ogg Vorbis (.ogg), 44.1 kHz; one-shots mono (sfx, ui), everything else stereo
conventions.variants: `variants` lists interchangeable takes; pick one at random per play and avoid repeating the previous pick. `file` is the first variant.
conventions.volume: `default_volume_db` is the suggested AudioStreamPlayer volume_db; `default_volume` is the same as a linear gain.
conventions.loops: `loop` is null for one-shots. For loops set AudioStreamOggVorbis.loop = true and loop_offset = loop.start_s; the file is sample-exact (end_sample = length), seam-checked on the decoded audio.
conventions.music_sync: Entries sharing `music.sync_group` have the same bpm, bars and length: start them together (or seek to the same position) to crossfade or layer them.
conventions.levels: music/layers/ambience are normalised to integrated LUFS targets; sfx/ui/stings to a common peak per bus (see `buses`). `levels` is measured on the decoded .ogg.
